authors: Zhuohao (Jerry) Zhang, Ruiqi Chen, Mingyuan Zhong, Jacob O. Wobbrock
selection: 40 public Gemini-origin pages: 32 train + 8 validation; original split retained; unique PNG SHA; at most two pages per source group; no test pages.
